questions.text: A key reason CNNs are parameter-efficient compared to fully connected nets for images is:
options: Weight sharing and local receptive fields
They never use nonlinearities thus easier to train
Compared to vanilla neural network and RNN, they are robust to gradient explosion and vanishing gradient.
questions.correct_answer: Weight sharing and local receptive fields

questions.text: Stacking multiple 3×3 convolutions (stride 1) increases receptive field because:
options: Each layer composes local neighborhoods into larger effective context
It removes nonlinearities thereby increasing the effective context
It forces global averaging thereby increasing the contribution of input pixels
questions.correct_answer: Each layer composes local neighborhoods into larger effective context

questions.text: In Faster R-CNN, the Region Proposal Network (RPN) outputs:

questions.text: Vanishing gradients in vanilla RNNs occur mainly due to:
